title: Fishers of Men
description: After a night of catching nothing, the fishermen let down their nets at Jesus's word and caught so many fish that the nets began to break. They left everything to follow Him.

title: Matthew Leaves the Tax Table
description: Jesus called a tax collector to follow Him, then ate with publicans and sinners, teaching that He came to call sinners to repentance.

title: The Twelve Are Ordained
place: A mountain near the Sea of Galilee
description: After praying all night on a mountain, Jesus called His disciples and chose twelve of them, whom He named apostles.

title: Sent Forth Two by Two
description: Jesus sent the apostles out in pairs with nothing for their journey. They preached repentance, cast out devils, and anointed and healed the sick.

title: Five Loaves and Two Fishes
description: Philip wondered how so many could be fed, and Andrew found a boy with a small lunch. Jesus fed five thousand men, with twelve baskets left over.

title: Walking on the Water
description: In a storm, Peter stepped out of the boat and walked toward Jesus. When he became afraid and began to sink, Jesus caught him.

title: Thou Art the Christ
description: When Jesus asked, "Whom say ye that I am?" Peter testified that He was the Christ, the Son of the living God, a truth revealed by the Father.

title: The Transfiguration
description: Jesus was transfigured before three apostles. His face shone like the sun, Moses and Elias appeared, and the Father's voice spoke from a cloud.

title: The Last Supper
description: Jesus introduced the sacrament, washed the apostles' feet, and taught them to love one another as He had loved them.

title: Gethsemane and the Betrayal
description: Jesus asked three apostles to watch with Him while He prayed in agony. Later that night, Judas came with a crowd and identified Him with a kiss.

title: The Empty Tomb
description: After Mary Magdalene reported that the tomb was empty, Peter and John ran to see. They found the linen clothes lying there, but the Lord was risen.

title: Feed My Sheep
place: Shore of the Sea of Tiberias
description: The risen Lord appeared to apostles who had returned to fishing. Three times He asked Peter, "Lovest thou me?" and told him, "Feed my sheep."

title: The Day of Pentecost
description: The Holy Ghost descended upon the apostles. Peter preached boldly, and about three thousand people were baptized that day.

title: The Road to Damascus
description: Saul, a persecutor of the Church, saw a light from heaven and heard the voice of Jesus. He was baptized and soon preached Christ in the synagogues.

title: The First Missionary Journey
description: Sent out from Antioch, Paul and Barnabas preached in Cyprus, Pisidian Antioch, Iconium, Lystra, and Derbe, opening the door of faith to the Gentiles.
